useful_opportunity: Expose policy order and separate success pricing from rejection decisions without hiding the rules behind machinery.
quality_evidence: Readers can locate and change a rejection rule without tracing nested success branches.
Precedence is explicit and base fees/surcharges remain understandable.
Helpers or tables, if used, carry actual policy concepts rather than one wrapper per statement.
no_op_policy: Unchanged branching or cosmetic reformatting alone is incomplete.
major_harms: Changed fee threshold or member discount
